summary: Google's toolkit for running machine learning on phones, web, desktop and edge devices, with ready solutions for vision, text, audio and LLMs.

heroCommands.command: Pick a solution and follow its developer guide at developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: MediaPipe is Google's framework for on-device machine learning. It has ready-made solutions you can customise and deploy to Android, iOS, web, desktop, edge devices and IoT, covering vision, text, audio, retrieval, decisions and generative AI.
sixtySeconds.problem: Running ML in apps on-device is hard to build from scratch. MediaPipe gives you tested solutions and tools for live and streaming media.
whoFor: Mobile and web developers adding ML features
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for Google-maintained, cross-platform on-device ML with demos and guides for each solution.
requirements: A development setup for your platform: Android, iOS, Python or web

overview: MediaPipe Solutions include audio classification, decision making, LLM inference, semantic retrieval, text classification and vision tasks such as object detection.
Start with the developer guide for the solution you need, and the setup guide for Android, iOS, Python or web apps. Web demos let you try solutions first.
The primary documentation is at developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe. MediaPipe is Apache 2.0 licensed.
